oracleMethod: Ten expected whole ASTs are copied unchanged from frozen Phase148 literal controls. Seven additional expected ASTs are written from the cited declarations, without executing a reference or candidate. Host construction only serializes literal ADT trees and the fixed identity hash; it does not evaluate the optimizer.

audit.identity: Canonical v_<U32> names are numeric binders; noncanonical spellings remain exact Named values. Binder and Named hash collisions require tagged equality.
audit.storage: Dedicated immutable facts contain value, epoch, conditional relation and predicate provenance. No arrays or KDef/KTerm metadata records are constructed.
audit.joins: Continuing-arm joins retain ordinary facts present in both arms, reset their epochs through insertion and discard provenance; one terminal arm preserves the live arm facts.
audit.boundary: A final decoded original function remains the independent verification/output boundary. All conversion is charged by the root harness.
